history.summary: Listed as a 1BR but 1033sqft — this is a bedroom/sqft mismatch; it is almost certainly a 3BR (or large 2BR) misclassified by the scraper, which makes the low $929 psf look deceptively cheap. Taken as the larger unit it actually is, $960k for a 1033sqft 99yr unit in D23 with a reliable 5.4% CAGR (139 txns) at ~11% below median PSF is a solid value entry.
history.rating_rationale: 1033sqft cannot be a 1BR — the listing is misclassified, so judge it as a ~3BR. On that basis $929 psf vs $1046 median is ~11% cheap, the 5.4% CAGR is reliable over 139 txns (strong for OCR D23), and $960k quantum is highly liquid. Caveat: 1999 build (27 years old) with ~72yr lease remaining is the main drag — aging but not yet financing-impaired. The value and verified appreciation outweigh the age for a value buy.
